# Vanity.box

> Vanity.box (Vanity) connects blockchain wallet addresses, readable names and digital ID profiles for a unified Web3 identity.

## About Vanity
Vanity Wallet and Vanity ID describe Vanity's wallet and digital identity experience. Users can link wallets and view decentralised identity profiles with social links, tokens, NFTs and blockchain activity. ENS names, including .eth and .box, resolve to Web3 profiles.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://vanity.box/): Vanity's blockchain wallet and Web3 digital ID application
- [Vanity.box profile](https://vanity.box/vanity.box)
- [Privacy Policy](https://vanity.box/privacy-policy)
- [Terms of Use](https://vanity.box/terms-of-use)

## Supported
ENS (.eth, .box), Basenames, IOTA names, Unstoppable Domains (.vanity, .x), TON, Sui, Aptos, World Chain.
